# Emmaventure Safaris

> Emmaventure Safaris Ltd is a Tanzania-based tour operator in Arusha, Tanzania, running private, personally hosted safaris in Northern Tanzania, Mount Kilimanjaro treks, and Zanzibar extensions. Founded and hosted by Emmanuel, who grew up at the foot of Kilimanjaro and has guided for over ten years, and Dewi, originally from the Netherlands.

## Facts
- Location: Arusha, Tanzania
- Contact: WhatsApp +255 744 228 747 · sales@emmaventuresafaris.com
- Operates in: Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire, Ndutu, Mount Kilimanjaro, Zanzibar
- Trip styles: private tailor-made journeys, one small-group fixed departure, Kilimanjaro treks
- Published price: Small Group Luxury Safari, 7 days, USD 6,900 per person

## Journeys
- [Small Group Luxury Safari](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/small-group-luxury-safari/): 7 days. Join Emmanuel for a 7-day luxury adventure through Northern Tanzania’s most iconic landscapes, from Tarangire’s baobabs and the Ngorongoro Highlands to the endless plains of the Serengeti.
- [Soul of Tanzania Journey](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/soul-of-tanzania-journey/): 11 days. An 11-day journey through Northern Tanzania for travellers seeking a meaningful blend of safari, nature, and deep connection with local life and culture.
- [Heart of Tanzania Journey](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/heart-of-tanzania-journey/): 9 days. A 9-day journey through Northern Tanzania, designed for travellers seeking a meaningful blend of safari, nature, and deep connection with local life and culture.
- [The Timeless Safari Experience](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/the-timeless-safari-experience/): 10 days. A 10-day safari through Northern Tanzania at a gentle, enjoyable pace. From the moment you arrive with VIP airport service, Emmanuel and Dewi are your hosts throughout.
- [The Direct Wilderness Experience](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/the-direct-wilderness-safari-experience/): 7 days. A 7-day safari through Northern Tanzania, venturing straight into the heart of the wilderness from the moment you arrive.
- [Great Migration — River Crossing](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/great-migration-river-crossing-experience/): 7 days. A 7-day Great Migration safari through Northern Tanzania, venturing straight into the heart of the wilderness for the river crossings.
- [Great Migration — Ndutu Calving](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/great-migration-ndutu-calving-experience/): 6 days. A 6-day safari during the Ndutu calving season in the Southern Serengeti, at a relaxed and thoughtfully curated pace.
- [Serengeti Fly-In Experience](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/serengeti-fly-in-safari-experience/): 4 days. A 4-day fly-in safari through the Serengeti. Travel by domestic flight from Arusha, Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar directly into Seronera.
- [Transformative Incentives](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/journeys/transformative-incentives/): 4 days. A 4-day incentive in Northern Tanzania, thoughtfully designed for connection, adventure, reflection, celebration, and purposefully looking ahead.

## Kilimanjaro
- [7-Day Machame Route](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/kilimanjaro/machame-7-day/): 7 days. The Machame Route is known for its challenging yet rewarding trails, diverse landscapes, and a climb-high, sleep-low approach — ideal for proper acclimatisation while enjoying a scenic and adventurous ascent.
- [8-Day Lemosho Route](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/kilimanjaro/lemosho-8-day/): 8 days. The Lemosho Route is known for its quiet trails, varied landscapes and excellent acclimatisation, making it one of the most balanced and scenic ways to climb Kilimanjaro.

## Destinations
- [Serengeti National Park](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/destinations/serengeti/): Fourteen thousand square kilometres of plain, and the stage for the Great Migration.
- [Ngorongoro Crater](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/destinations/ngorongoro/): A collapsed volcanic caldera holding roughly 25,000 large animals inside its walls.
- [Tarangire National Park](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/destinations/tarangire/): Baobab country along a river that draws the whole ecosystem in through the dry season.
- [Zanzibar](https://aisafarimarketing-ux.github.io/emmaventure-safaris/destinations/zanzibar/): A short flight from Arusha, and the natural second half of a Tanzania journey.

## Questions
### Who is Emmaventure Safaris?
Emmaventure Safaris is a Tanzania-based tour operator founded by Emmanuel, who grew up at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro and has guided in Northern Tanzania for over ten years, and his wife Dewi, who is originally from the Netherlands. They personally host the private safaris they design.

### Where does Emmaventure Safaris operate?
Northern Tanzania — the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire and the Ndutu area — plus Mount Kilimanjaro treks and Zanzibar beach extensions. The company is based in Arusha.

### What does a safari with Emmaventure cost?
The Small Group Luxury Safari is a fixed-departure trip at USD 6,900 per person for 7 days. Private tailor-made journeys are quoted individually, because cost depends on season, camps and group size.

### Are the safaris private or group?
Most journeys are private and personally hosted. The Small Group Luxury Safari is the exception: a fixed-date, guaranteed-departure trip you can join.

### When is the best time to see the Great Migration?
January to March for the Ndutu calving season in the southern Serengeti, and July to October for the river crossings in the north. Emmaventure runs a dedicated journey for each.

### Does Emmaventure arrange Kilimanjaro climbs?
Yes. They run the 7-day Machame Route and the 8-day Lemosho Route. Emmanuel has worked as a Kilimanjaro assistant guide.

### How do I book or ask a question?
WhatsApp Emmanuel on +255 744 228 747 for a same-day response, or email sales@emmaventuresafaris.com.
